{{Quote|This&hellip; officer recently quarreled with one of our Chiss delegates. The delegate did not survive.|Officer [[Breerdin]]|<ref name="TOR" />}}
A [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] served as a '''delegate''' representing the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. However, the delegate was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in a fight with an [[Unidentified Imperial officer (Chiss delegate)|Imperial officer]] in the [[Sunken Sarlacc cantina]], forcing the Empire to frame the [[Balmorran resistance]] for the crime.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Chiss delegate's body appears in the mission "Body of Evidence" for players on the Imperial version of Balmorra in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
